Name: Jehoash, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoash, also called Joash, son of Jehoahaz, recovered from Ben-Hadad the cities Syria had taken, visited the dying Elisha, and captured Amaziah of Judah at Beth-shemesh.
KeyStory: Jehoash recovers Israel's cities and captures Amaziah.
RelatedPeople: Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria; Amaziah, King of Judah; Jeroboam II, King of Israel
LifeLesson: God gives victories even to imperfect kings, for His people's sake.
